This image appears to show a post-mortem or surgical dissection of the abdominal region.

The skin and subcutaneous tissues have been incised and reflected (pulled back) to expose the underlying structures. The bluish-grey area visible in the center is the abdominal cavity, likely showing the peritoneum (the serous membrane lining the cavity) covering the internal organs.

Therefore, the abdomen is present and has been opened to reveal the abdominal cavity.
